integrity: Analytic all-r and asymptotic proof; exact-rational and numerical finite checks confirm identities. Novelty is qualified by incomplete historical indexing, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only Gaussian real sketches; full-rank sign classification qualitative; sharp negative-tail probability and its prefactor only for nonzero rank-one inputs and deterministic fixed/variance-oracle weights. Non-Gaussian, random estimated weights, clipping bias and finite precision not studied.
title: Sharp sign-safety and negative-tail law for weighted Hutch# Frobenius estimation
